name: dxf-export-simple
description: IXT-SUITES simple rung for the `dxfExport` flag (pro tier): hidden in Simple mode's File menu, visible in Pro, and a real click on "Export DXF (CAD)" drives the actual downloadPlanDxf() blob-download path (intercepted via a patched HTMLAnchorElement.click so the harness can assert the produced filename/blob without a real file download).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: verify-simple-mode
steps.failMessage: App did not boot in Simple mode — expected uiMode=simple

steps.name: assert-dxf-hidden-simple
steps.eval: (function(){ const t = document.querySelector('.pop-panel')?.textContent || ''; if (t.includes('Export DXF')) throw new Error('Export DXF row visible in Simple mode File menu (should be Pro-only)'); })()

steps.name: assert-dxf-visible-pro
steps.eval: (function(){ const t = document.querySelector('.pop-panel')?.textContent || ''; if (!t.includes('Export DXF')) throw new Error('Export DXF row missing in Pro mode File menu: ' + t); })()

steps.name: patch-anchor-click
steps.eval: window.__dxfClicks = []; window.__origAnchorClick = HTMLAnchorElement.prototype.click; HTMLAnchorElement.prototype.click = function () { window.__dxfClicks.push({ href: this.href, download: this.download }); };

steps.name: click-export-dxf
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn = [...document.querySelectorAll('.pop-panel button')].find(b => b.textContent.includes('Export DXF')); if (!btn) throw new Error('Export DXF button not found'); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: wait-dxf-download
steps.failMessage: downloadPlanDxf() never produced an anchor click (blob build/import likely failed)

steps.name: assert-dxf-output
steps.eval: (function(){ const c = window.__dxfClicks[0]; if (!c.href.startsWith('blob:')) throw new Error('DXF anchor href is not a blob URL: ' + c.href); if (!c.download.endsWith('.dxf')) throw new Error('DXF anchor download name missing .dxf extension: ' + c.download); HTMLAnchorElement.prototype.click = window.__origAnchorClick; })()

steps.name: assert-dxf-hidden-simple-again
steps.eval: (function(){ const t = document.querySelector('.pop-panel')?.textContent || ''; if (t.includes('Export DXF')) throw new Error('Export DXF row visible after switching back to Simple mode'); })()
